item.title: Odd Lots: What Happens When Billionaires Turn to Politics
item.description:
[Bloomberg] What happens when simply getting rich is not enough and billionaires continue to strive for something greater?
Stanford Professor Francis Fukuyama joins Tracy Alloway and Joe Weisenthal on the Odd Lots podcast to discuss what drives the richest and most powerful people in the world and what happens when their ambitions get entangled with politics. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Stanford Professor Fukuyama on Today’s Extremist Ideology
item.description:
[Bloomberg] Francis Fukuyama's 1989 essay “The End of History?” argued that liberal democracy would not only defeat communism, but that its partisans might miss the “courage, imagination and idealism” that defined the ideological battle.
The Stanford professor joins Tracy Alloway and Joe Weisenthal on the Odd Lots podcast to discuss how his argument has evolved since the end of the Cold War and what's driving today's extremist ideology. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Lazard's Van Nostrand Says Markets Are Entering a Supply-Side Era

He speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
